programs.title: Dharam Chakara (dharam Chakaram Tamil 1997)
programs.desc: A village leader who loses a fight to his enemy Arumugam, causing the death of his lover Vijayalakshmi. Years later, another woman named Vijayalakshmi enters the village, and Chakkaravarthy defends her from Arumugam's goons, rekindling his fight for justice.

programs.title: Parwana
programs.desc: Parwana spends his days brightening the lives of the downtrodden with a series of odd jobs. Just as Parwana falls in love and marries the girl of his dreams, a group of vicious criminals label him a traitor and Parwana is thrown behind bars. Despite the mafia's best attempts to permanently silent Parwana as he languishes in jail, the daring hero escapes and sets out on a mission to clear his name and expose the real criminals.

programs.title: Patth
programs.desc: Summaries. Avi comes from a poor family and lives with his mother and sister, Nandini. He sees that Nandini has befriended a local gangster by the name of Bhullar, and quietly resents this. When Nandini is killed, Avi and two male friends, Golu and Hari, decide to avenge her death - by killing Bhullar.

programs.title: Kuch Toh Hai
programs.desc: The movie follows the story of a young couple who move into a new house, only to discover that it is haunted by a mysterious presence. As they try to unravel the truth behind the entity, they uncover a dark secret that threatens their very existence.
